title: A playback decision line names the mode's subtitle though it was dropped and the film direct played with none
notes: Operator only: the line can show method=direct_play and subtitle_asked=none beside the planned subtitle's index, codec and language when no worker can burn it; the reply has no subtitle. Promote on one dogfood playback decision line with method=direct_play and a subtitle_index, or a deployment with no transcodeStore in use. Otherwise it joins JS-022 as one criterion when that task starts.
